programme.title: BSc Information and Communication Technology
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science, 3 years, 180 ECTS; autumn start (related programme, not titled Computer Science)
programme.how_found: kth.se/en/studies/bachelor -> 'BSc Information and Communication Technology' and its Entry requirements / Fees / How to apply pages.
programme.notes: RELATED case: KTH has no bachelor titled Computer Science. Answers below are for the English-taught BSc ICT (the only bachelor with an international round). The subject-closest programme, Civilingenjör Datateknik 300 hp (https://www.kth.se/utbildning/civilingenjor/datateknik/datateknik-civilingenjor-300-hp-1.4116), is Swedish-taught, five years, admits through the Swedish national round ('15 april: Sista anmälningsdag' for autumn 2026) with särskild behörighet 'Fysik 2, Kemi 1, Matematik 4 eller Matematik E' (behorighet-och-antagning-1.924447).

english.quote: You can meet the requirement with an English test, for example an IELTS total score of 6.5 with no section below 5.5
english.notes: Requirement is 'English 6/English Level 2'. TOEFL: 'a TOEFL total score of 90 with score of 20 (scale 0-30) in the writing section (test results 20 January 2026 and earlier) or TOEFL total score of 4.5 (scale 1-6) with no section less than 4 (test results 21 January 2026 and later)'. Full list of accepted tests is on universityadmissions.se (not an official KTH domain; not read).

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published. Prose: 'Admission is highly competitive, with far fewer places than qualified applicants. In 2024, 10% of eligible applicants were admitted.' Subject requirement Mathematics 4 and Physics 2 (passing grade); IB route 'International Baccalaureate Diploma with 24 points' (an IB points minimum, not a GPA).

deadline.notes: Under 'Application deadlines for studies starting 2027' -> 'Application round 1': 'Non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens should apply in round 1'; opens '16 October (2026)'. The year 2027 is in the heading, not in the quoted line. Documents and application fee by 1 February. 'The application deadlines below are strict and in Central European Time (CET).'

value.population: non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens, BSc Information and Communication Technology

tuition.quote: The full programme tuition fee for non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens studying the bachelor's programme in Information and Communication Technology is SEK 453,000.
tuition.notes: Published as a whole-programme figure, not per year; academic year not stated (page last changed Feb 17, 2025). Charged per semester in advance. Application fee SEK 900. Not multiplied or divided.

scholarship_exists.quote: We do not offer any scholarships for bachelor's studies.
scholarship_exists.notes: Also: 'KTH does not offer any scholarships for the Bachelor’s programme in Information and Communication Technology.' KTH scholarships are for master's studies only.

scholarship_international.quote: We do not offer any scholarships for bachelor's studies.
scholarship_international.notes: No bachelor scholarship exists, so there is none for internationals.
